projects.title: PixelNimbus
projects.description: This project is an AI-powered Image and Video Optimization Platform designed to help users enhance their media content for faster performance and better engagement.
projects.longDescription: This project is an AI-powered Image and Video Optimization Platform designed to help users enhance their media content for faster performance and better engagement. Built with a modern frontend and robust backend, the platform allows users to upload images and videos, where the system automatically applies compression, resizing, and format conversion without compromising quality. Leveraging AI-based suggestions, it provides recommendations for ideal resolutions, aspect ratios, color enhancements, and thumbnail generation to optimize media for different platforms (web, mobile, and social media).
features: AI-powered image and video optimization with intelligent enhancement suggestions
Media upload system with automatic compression, resizing, and format conversion
Smart recommendations for resolutions, aspect ratios, color improvements, and thumbnails
Fast, responsive UI built for seamless media processing and user experience
Scalable frontend and backend architecture optimized for web, mobile, and social media delivery

projects.title: Askly
projects.description: A full-stack AI-powered search engine that delivers Perplexity-style answers by combining live web search, AI reasoning, citations, images, and chat history.
projects.longDescription: Askly is an AI-powered search application built to deliver a modern answer engine experience similar to Perplexity AI. Users can ask natural language questions and receive clear, AI-generated responses enriched with citations, web sources, and relevant images. The platform performs real-time web searches using Tavily API, processes results through Groq's Llama 3 model, and generates concise, source-backed answers. Built with a scalable full-stack architecture, Askly includes authentication, persistent chat history, media-rich responses, and cloud deployment for a seamless search experience across devices.
features: AI-powered web search that retrieves real-time information with source citations
Natural language question answering using Groq Llama 3 for fast and accurate responses
Integrated search results with images, references, and structured answer generation
Secure authentication and persistent chat history powered by Supabase
Modern, responsive interface optimized for fast search and seamless user experience
